bulk.copyAtomic: Every item is copied from its saved version, or none is: the engine copies them beside their targets first and moves them into place only when all are complete. An existing file or folder with the same name is never overwritten. Folders that contain symbolic links are refused, and one copy is limited to 5,000 entries and 256 MiB.
bulk.copyText: Text files are copied from their saved version; an existing file or folder with the same name is never overwritten. A folder is copied only when all of its listed files are text (at most 200 files, 8 MiB); otherwise nothing of it is copied. Hidden entries, skipped folders such as .git and node_modules, and symbolic links to files are not listed by the engine and are not copied.
